COLUMNS in EVERY row: 1 front three-quarter toward screen LOWER RIGHT; 2 true back three-quarter toward UPPER RIGHT, back clearly shown; 3 true back three-quarter toward UPPER LEFT; 4 front three-quarter toward LOWER LEFT.
ROWS: 1 standing ready; 2 left-foot-forward walking; 3 visibly opposite right-foot-forward walking; 4 the specified attack directed along that column's facing. Keep weapons held, charm/flag/armor connected to the actor. No loose projectiles, floating charms, dust, detached particles or weapon effects. No detached accessories. No text, labels, frames, lines, floor, scenery, ground shadows, background colour, checkerboard, bloom or baked ambient glow. True alpha-zero empty background. The game supplies ground shadows.
Primary priority: match the approved softly painted heroes while maintaining this unit's distinctive silhouette and readable palette at small battlefield size.
NAMED ACTOR: 승병 (monk). In image 1 choose ONLY row 4, column 2, counted from top left.
